# SD13-E4-R3 wizard level 1 prepared arcane spell-burden baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard level 1 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and stays a single-class, level-1-only prepared spell-bearing baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every spell-support surface: no spellbook, no spells prepared,
# no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no school specialization mechanic,
# no arcane bond resolution, no opposed-school bookkeeping, and no general spell totals.
# It adds only the minimum choice data needed to make the Wizard class identity, the
# school specialization burden, and the prepared spellbook / spells-prepared / spell-slot
# posture burden legible; those burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix
# to name as still blocking.
